title: Sajdat as-sahw – the prostration of forgetfulness
intro: Two extra sajdahs that fix a mistake we made in Salah without meaning to.

learn.html: We learned that sajdah is a part of Salah and the greatest sign of obedience and thanks to Allah. Sajdat as-sahw is an extra sajdah we make to correct a mistake we made in Salah without meaning to.

learn.text: We must make sajdat as-sahw if we…

items: forget a wajib of Salah – Al-Fatiha, the surah, the Qunut dua, At-Tahiyyat or the first sitting
are late with a wajib – we forget the first sitting, stand up for the 3rd rak‘ah, and go back to sit
are late with a fard – in the 3rd or 4th rak‘ah of a fard we add a surah after Al-Fatiha and so are late for ruku‘
pray more rak‘ahs than we should – five instead of four
are not sure how many rak‘ahs we prayed – then we count the smaller number
At the end of Salah we give the salam to the right side only
Then we make two sajdahs, just like the normal sajdahs of Salah
We sit again and recite At-Tahiyyat, the salawat and the duas
We give the salam to the right and left

learn.title: Good to know
learn.html: If we forget to make it right after the salam, we can still make it while we are in the place where we prayed. One sajdat as-sahw fixes one mistake or several. Someone praying behind an imam does not make it for their own mistake, but makes it together with the imam when the imam makes it.

learn.title: 💬 Talk with your muallim
learn.html: Sajdat as-sahw: I understood my mistake, I admitted it, and I corrected it!

practice.title: Making sajdat as-sahw
items: Salam to the right and left

practice.title: When do we make sajdat as-sahw?
practice.prompt: Tap every mistake that needs sajdat as-sahw, then tap Check.

options.text: We forgot the first sitting and stood up
We forgot the surah after Al-Fatiha
We prayed five rak‘ahs instead of four
We added a surah in the 3rd rak‘ah of a fard

options.why: Eating breaks Salah – we pray it again; sajdat as-sahw can’t fix it.
Without wudu Salah is broken – we make wudu and pray again.

options: Extra sajdahs to fix a mistake made without meaning to
A sajdah we make every morning

questions.q: How many sajdahs is sajdat as-sahw?

options: After the salam to the right side

questions.q: Not sure if you prayed 3 or 4 rak‘ahs – what do you count?
You pray behind the imam and make a small mistake. What do you do?
